about.heading: About Us
about.vision: Gaon Connect is building India's trusted platform for tractor, JCB, tempo, and agricultural machinery booking, making rural services faster, transparent, and easily accessible.
about.point1: To bridge the gap between rural needs and reliable transport & machinery services through technology.
about.point2: A India where every village has instant access to trusted vehicles and machinery, just a tap away.
about.point3: Transparency, fair pricing, and trust — built with and for rural communities.
about.leadershipSub: The people building GaonConnect for rural India.
about.founderBio: Prince Patel is the Founder & CEO of GaonConnect. He started GaonConnect with the vision of connecting villages through technology and making transportation more accessible, reliable, and affordable for rural communities across India.
about.cofounderBio: Vipin Patel is the Co-Founder of GaonConnect. He works closely on operations and driver partnerships, building the on-ground network that keeps rides available and affordable in villages and small towns.

items.name: Ramesh Kumar
items.text: Booking a tractor used to take all day. Now I get one in minutes. Truly a game changer for farmers like me!

items.name: Sunita Devi
items.text: Affordable rates and the drivers are always polite and verified. I trust GaonConnect for all my travel needs.

items.name: Anil Yadav
items.text: Booked a JCB for our farmland in just a few clicks. Transparent pricing, no hidden charges.

items.q: How do I book a vehicle on GaonConnect?
items.a: Simply download the app, select your service, enter pickup and drop location, and confirm your booking.

items.q: Is GaonConnect available in my village?
items.a: We are rapidly expanding across rural and urban India. Check the app for availability in your area.
We accept Cash, UPI, and wallet payments for your convenience.

items.q: How do I become a driver partner?
items.a: Click on 'Become a Partner', fill in your vehicle details, and our team will reach out to you for verification.

items.q: Is it safe to travel with GaonConnect?
items.a: Yes, all drivers are verified and every ride includes real-time tracking for your safety.
